info.description:
Bitvore Deprecated APIs. These APIs are still functional, but will be phased out. Please transition to the latest API version to avoid possible disruption.

* The Intelligence API has been replaced by the Corp News API.
* The Municipal Bond API has been replaced by the Muni News API.
info.title: Deprecated Custom APIs

get.description:
Intelligence is returned for a single bond identified by a CUSIP. Intelligence can be pulled for at most 30 days. A specific timeframe can be specified in the call using a date range or a number of days back in time. An example of a request is as follows:

    GET /cusip/008000AA7?offset=3&tz=GMT HTTP 1.1
    Accept: application/json
    X-CLIENTAPP-APPID: BVAPI

An example of a response is below.

parameters.name: cusip
parameters.description: cusip

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Intelligence published date to start from. Format is yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Intelligence published date to end with. Format is yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone used in startDate and endDate.

get.summary: Search for intelligence by state and sector.
get.description:
Intelligence is returned for a state and sector Intelligence can be pulled for at most 30 days. A specific timeframe can be specified in the call using a date range or a number of days back in time. An example of a request is as follows:

    GET /stateSector/ca/education?offset=3&tz=GMT HTTP 1.1
    Accept: application/json
    X-CLIENTAPP-APPID: BVAPI

An example of a response is below.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State (two character state code) to query about.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Sector to query about, i.e., Education.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Intelligence published date to start from. Format is yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Intelligence published date to end with. Format is yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone used in startDate and endDate.

get.description:
Intelligence is returned for companies, cusips, states, cities, or sectors baed on supplied parameters. Intelligence can be pulled for at most 31 days. A specific timeframe can be specified in the call using a date range or a number of days back in time.

Corporate intelligence can be gathered by searching with a Bitvore ID (BvId) identifying a company, a portfolio ID (a named set of companies), a coprorate business signal, or a foreign ID mapped to a company using the Identification API. An example of a request using a BvId is as follows:

    GET /intelapi/intel?bvId=b1000abc&offset=3&tz=GMT HTTP 1.1
    Accept: application/json
    X-CLIENTAPP-APPID: BVAPI

Municipal and economic intelligence can be gathered by searching with a CUSIP, city, state, or sector. An example of using a cusip is:

    GET /intelapi/intel?cusip=123456789&offset=3&tz=GMT HTTP 1.1
    Accept: application/json
    X-CLIENTAPP-APPID: BVAPI

An example of using a state and sector is:

    GET /intelapi/intel?state=ca&sector=education&offset=3&tz=GMT HTTP 1.1
    Accept: application/json
    X-CLIENTAPP-APPID: BVAPI

An example of a response is below.

parameters.name: bvId
parameters.description: One or more Bitvore IDs identifying entities to retrieve corporate intel for, should not be used with other identifying parameters.

parameters.name: portfolioId
parameters.description: ID identifying a portfolio to retrieve intel for, should not be used with other identifying parameters.

parameters.name: cusip
parameters.description: One or more CUSIPs identifying the bonds to retrieve intel for, should not be used with other identifying parameters.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State to retrieve municipal and economic intel for. Must not be used with the bvId or cusip parameters.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City to retrieve municipal and economic intel for, must be used with the state parameter and not with the bvId or cusip parameters.

parameters.name: sector
parameters.description: Sector to retrieve municipal and economic intel for, must be used with the state parameter and not with the bvId, cusip, or economic parameters.

parameters.name: economic
parameters.description: Restrict to economic news for an area, must be used with the state or city parameter and notwith the bvId, cusip, or sector parameters.

parameters.name: signal
parameters.description: One or more signals (i.e., Bankruptcy, Wrongdoing) to restrict the returned corporate intel to.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Keyword or phrase to search for intel when not using a portfolio

parameters.name: foreignId
parameters.description: One or more Foreign IDs identifying the entities to retrieve corporate intel for, the IDs must be registered in an identification scheme associated with the API client.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Intelligence published date to start from. Format is yyyy-mm-dd for daily intel or yyyy-mm-dd'T'HH:mm if you want it down to the hour or minute. Should not be used if offset parameter is.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Intelligence published date to end with. Format is yyyy-mm-dd for daily (inclusive) intel or yyyy-mm-dd'T'HH:mm if you want it down to the hour or minute. If startDate is used and endDate is not the default endDate is today.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of days back intelligence should be returned for. Should not be used with startDate.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: Timezone used in startDate and endDate.

parameters.name: dateType
parameters.description: Indicates whether dates to query by should be published dates "published" or available dates (processing completed) "available". Default is published.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of record to return.

parameters.name: significance
parameters.description: Significance of records to return, possible values are "HIGH" and "MEDIUM", default is "HIGH". The parameter is a threshold so a value of MEDIUM will return MEDIUM and HIGH significant records.

success.description: Indicates whether the call was successful or not
